translations.web: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
translations.bsb: If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
translations.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
translations.asv: And if the firstfruit is holy, so is the lump: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.
